quest.title: A Garden Gathering
quest.description: Go to the hidden dwelling, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Columbina...

talks.objective: Go to the hidden dwelling to start the tea party

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Is this where you used to live? It's pretty.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: It used to be even prettier. I have quite a knack for gardening, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: What are you laughing about now...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: I was just picturing you crouching down, tending to the flowers. It's an adorable image.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Can I take a look inside?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Of course. I've already cleaned and dusted.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: What are you going to do with the place?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hmm... I think I still want to hold onto it. I can come back and tidy up whenever I have the time.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: If you're busy, I can help take care of it for you.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: It gives me the same feeling your old room used to. It's comforting... A happy place.

talks.objective: Go to the hidden dwelling to start the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Alright, let's come back another time.
